title: #095. Shift Rostering via Column Generation
subtitle: Generate valid multi-day staff shift schedules dynamically from dual prices using WaSHI solveColumnGeneration.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { selectedColumns, counts, totalCost }.
judge.m1: Field "selectedColumns" must be an array of binary shift vectors.
judge.m2: counts[{p0}] must be a non-negative integer (received {p1}).
judge.m5: Shift pattern {p0} has {p1} consecutive work days, exceeding maxConsecutive ({p2}).
judge.m6: Day {p0} receives {p1} assigned workers, below demand ({p2}).
judge.m7: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match recomputed shift cost ({p1}).
judge.m8: All shift rules and daily demands are satisfied, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
